problem.title: Right now, your wedding lives in fifty places.
problem.body: When coordination is scattered across fractured platforms, family joy gets overshadowed by administrative stress.

whatsapp.title: A family group with 400 unread messages
whatsapp.body: Important updates and song choices drown between forwarded blessings and media downloads.

excel.title: A guest list in someone's Excel sheet
excel.body: Three diverging spreadsheet versions stored on uncles' laptops, each with a different count.

vendors.title: Vendor numbers saved in five phones
vendors.body: No shared record of which caterer you chose or who paid the decorator.

photos.title: Photos scattered across every phone
photos.body: Candid Haldi photos lost across dozens of individual chat threads.

problem.closing: Shaadioo brings it all into one shared, dignified plan.

plan.title: Plan together
plan.body: Invite parents, siblings and cousins to help without the chaos. Assign every task to one person and track each ceremony's deadlines from roka to the final reception.

points.one: Two simple roles for family: Admin and Manager
points.two: Shared task progress the whole family can see

invite.body: Create a personal invitation for every family and share it on WhatsApp, by email or however you prefer. Guests RSVP in seconds with no app download and no password.

points.two: Website and gallery kept out of search engines

guests.title: Your guests don't need an app.
guests.body: Frictionless for grandparents, aunts, cousins and overseas friends who value quick clarity over complex software.

link.title: Open from any invitation link
link.body: Guests tap their personal link to see their events, venues, directions and dress codes, and reply in seconds.

device.title: Works on any phone or screen
device.body: Clear, readable pages on older smartphones, entry-level Android phones, tablets and desktops alike.

password.title: No passwords, ever
password.body: Zero logins, zero forgotten passwords and no app store prompts. Each family's private link is all they need.

indian.title: Made for Indian weddings
indian.body: Western planning tools assume a single afternoon event for individual guests. Indian celebrations are a multi-day, whole-family affair.

events.title: Many events, each with its own guest list
events.body: Not everyone comes to the Haldi or the intimate early puja. Invite each family only to the events they're part of.

sides.title: Bride's side and groom's side
sides.body: Tag every guest by side and filter your list in one tap.

households.title: Invite whole families, not just individuals
households.body: Address the “Kapoor Parivar” as one invitation, with one headcount for the whole family.

rupees.title: Amounts in rupees (₹), the way you count them
rupees.body: Indian number formatting in lakhs and crores, and a clear record of who paid for what.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in three steps
howItWorks.body: Get your core dates online today without reading a single manual.

one.title: Create your wedding
one.body: Set your dates and add your ceremonies, from the Roka to the Reception, with times and venues.

two.title: Bring in your family
two.body: Invite siblings, parents and cousins as Admins or Managers. Everyone works from the same plan.

three.title: Share your invitations
three.body: Send each family its private link and watch RSVPs and headcounts come into your dashboard.

privacy.title: Private by design.
privacy.body: Your wedding is a sacred family milestone, not social media content. We never sell or share your family's data.

links.title: Private links only
links.body: Every invitation link is cryptographically unique to the family it was made for, and you can replace it at any time.

unlisted.title: Unlisted everywhere
unlisted.body: Your wedding website and gallery are hidden from Google and other search engines.

gallery.title: Private photo gallery
gallery.body: Only people with your gallery link or QR code can view or add photos.

delete.title: Delete everything, any time
delete.body: Delete your wedding and every guest's name, phone number, email, RSVP and photo is permanently removed.

free.a: Yes. Shaadioo is free for couples and families, with every core feature included: multi-event planning, your family workspace and RSVP tracking.

download.q: Do guests need to download anything?
download.a: No app download at all. Guests open their personal link in any phone or computer browser to RSVP or add photos.

parents.q: Can my parents use it easily?
parents.a: Yes. It's designed for parents and elders, with high contrast, readable text and no confusing menus. They can check the guest list and RSVPs without help.

guestList.q: Who can see our guest list?
guestList.a: Only the family members you invite to help plan, as Admins or Managers. Each guest sees only their own invitation and the events they're invited to.

photos.q: What happens to our photos after the wedding?
photos.a: Photos stay in your private gallery for 12 months after the wedding, and you can download them any time. We keep web-quality copies, not the original full-resolution files.

finalCta.title: Less chaos. More celebration.
finalCta.body: Bring your family together on Shaadioo and plan every ceremony the way it was meant to be.
finalCta.note: No credit card required · Free for families

footer.tagline: Designed and built for modern Indian families.
